recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman with voluminous, textured auburn hair and blue eyes, set against a vibrant magenta background. The composition features a mix of aggressive, hand-painted brush lettering and clean, spaced-out sans-serif typography, capturing a late 1980s pop music aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant magenta background complements the warm auburn tones of the hair.
The large, expressive script typography contrasts with the rigid, wide-tracked subtitle.
The subject's direct gaze creates an immediate focal point, framed by wild hair textures.
The purple garment provides a cool-toned anchor against the warm skin and hot pink backdrop.
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the viewer
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with a script main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the right, filling approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the high-contrast blue against the warm skin tones.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script title in the top left, moves down to the eyes, then follows the hair flow to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the top left corner to accommodate the primary title.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with high value contrast in the skin tones and white lettering.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, dry-brush strokes with visible bristle textures.
Letters in the main title are slanted and overlapping.
Subtitle uses all-caps, high-tracking, and uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'A' features an elongated crossbar that extends into a underline.
The underline has a rough, torn-paper or dry-brush edge.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, chaotic script paired with rigid, architectural sans-serif for balance.

preserve: Slanted orientation of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-painted feel of the main title.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s-style auburn hair, blue eyes, and large silver hoop earrings. The background should be a solid, vibrant magenta with a slight grainy texture. The lighting should be soft but directional, highlighting the hair's texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, aggressive brush-script title in the top left, tilted slightly upwards. Below it, add a subtitle in a white, bold, all-caps sans-serif font with very wide letter spacing. Include a rough, horizontal brush stroke underline beneath the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta background sufficiently saturated?
Does the script font have visible brush-stroke textures?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the width of the main title?
Is the hair texture prominent and detailed?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the brush strokes in the title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the magenta background.
Check that the hair texture doesn't look overly digital or smoothed.
Verify the wide tracking of the subtitle creates a horizontal anchor.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a physical album cover.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation color field portrait with dual-layered typography: one layer expressive/brushed and one layer rigid/geometric.
